tools.name: get_delivery_guidance
tools.description: Returns a few decision rules from the CDO Agent know-how for one delivery situation on software, integrations, data or connecting AI. Describe the situation in plain text. Never paste files, credentials or customer data.

tools.name: teach_delivery_topic
tools.description: Returns one short lesson from the CDO Agent know-how on one delivery topic so the user learns to make the decision themselves.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Returns the one playbook from the CDO Agent know-how for the type of situation: which facts to ask for, what to look up and the shape of the answer. Call it first. It never lists playbooks.

tools.name: ask_guarantor
tools.description: Sends a text question to the human guarantor. Uses the monthly quota of the plan. Use it only when CDO Agent has no verified answer or the user asks for a person. Text only.

tools.name: get_guarantor_replies
tools.description: Returns replies from the human guarantor that the user has not seen yet.

tools.name: request_delivery_help
tools.description: Sends a delivery request to the human guarantor, who can deliver the project with development and product management. Only after the user explicitly agrees: set consent to yes. Sends the summary, the timeframe, the company name and the e-mail of the account, nothing else. One request per account and

tools.name: dev_setup_instructions
tools.description: Returns the short block to add to the global instructions of the user's coding tool so it consults CDO Agent before proposals, reviews, releases and deploys. Works without a subscription. Add it only after the user agrees.
